charts.title: Hand-off pipeline — real output: the handed-off .ant run under the exact engine → MAP + derived shock margin
charts.caption: Real output of the composed four-verb pipeline (real_trajectories.json): the portable biogears_sepsis.ant, loaded into the exact Tellurium engine and run, produces a real MAP trajectory (baseline 95.5 mmHg, reaching 69.5 mmHg); the composed derivation step emits the shock margin below. The orchestration produced these numbers from the handed-off model — nothing here is drawn by hand. (The surrogate tier the pipeline also wires is profiled in studies 04–05.)
